# PAHWA JEE

> Meerut's trusted destination for authentic Nankhatai, Rewri, Gazak, traditional sweets, cakes, and premium gift hampers since 1928.

PAHWA JEE (also known as Pahwajee Rewri Wale and Ram Chandra Deewan Chandra Rewri Wale) is an iconic confectionery, bakery, and festive gifting brand established in 1928 in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, India. Renowned across generations for handcrafted Pure Desi Ghee Nankhatai, traditional Khasta Rewri, melt-in-mouth Dilkhush Gazak, artisanal winter laddoos, fresh cakes, and luxury dry fruit gift hampers.

- Website: https://pahwajee.in
- Phone / Orders: +91 6398431618, +91 9837566628
- WhatsApp Ordering: https://wa.me/916398431618
- Primary Store: 19B, Abu Lane, Meerut Cantt, Uttar Pradesh 250001, India
- Hours: 10:00 AM – 11:00 PM IST (Open 7 days a week)

## Core Categories & Collections

- [Rewri & Gajak](https://pahwajee.in/rewri-gajak-meerut): Famous Meerut sesame and organic jaggery specialties including Khasta Rewri, Gol Gazak, Dilkhush Gazak, Til Patti Gazak, Gur Roll Gazak, and Til Peanut Khasta.
- [Nankhatai](https://pahwajee.in/nankhatai-meerut): Legendary traditional Indian shortbread cookies baked fresh daily — Pure Desi Ghee Nankhatai (Rs 600/kg) and Vanaspati Ghee Nankhatai (Rs 380/kg).
- [Traditional Sweets & Laddoos](https://pahwajee.in/sweets-meerut): Handcrafted sweets including Dry Fruit Laddoo, Special Pishori Pinni, Til Bugga, Besan Laddoo, Motichoor Laddoo, and seasonal winter specialties.
- [Bakery & Cakes](https://pahwajee.in/bakery-meerut): Freshly baked celebration cakes, pastries, cookies, and bakery biscuits. Custom designer cakes available with 24 hours advance notice.
- [Gift Hampers & Corporate Gifting](https://pahwajee.in/gifting): Luxury handcrafted wooden trays and decorative gift boxes (Peacock, Golden, Floral, Ribbon) featuring premium dry fruits and sweets for weddings, corporate gifting, and festivals.
- [All Products Catalogue](https://pahwajee.in/products): Complete online shop catalogue with live pricing, availability, and 500g / 1kg pack options.
- [In-Store Menu](https://pahwajee.in/in-store-menu): Full dine-in & takeaway menu including thick shakes, fast food, snacks, and beverages.

## Ordering & Fulfilment

- **Website Cart & Checkout**: Customers can browse the live catalogue at https://pahwajee.in/products, add items in 500g or 1kg packs, and submit delivery or store pickup requests.
- **WhatsApp Direct Order**: Instant order inquiries via WhatsApp at https://wa.me/916398431618.
- **Local Delivery**: Delivery across Meerut usually costs Rs 40–80 depending on distance. Same-day delivery available for orders placed early.
- **Pan-India Courier**: Courier shipping across India is available for non-perishable signature products like Rewri, Gazak, and Nankhatai.
- **Payment Methods**: UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), credit/debit cards, net banking, and cash at store.
